name: Chamber of Commerce Committee Liaison Meeting Agenda
minutes_text:
CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 North Rexford Drive
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210
  Video Teleconference
  Beverly Hills City Council Chamber of Commerce Liaison Committee Meeting

  SPECIAL MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Friday, September 20, 2024
  11:00 AM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  September 20, 2024 / 11:00 AM
IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor Lester Friedman, Councilmember Mary Wells, Deputy City Manager
  Keith Sterling, Community Outreach Manager Magdalena Davis, Beverly
  Hills Chamber of Commerce Director of Economic Development &
  Government Affairs Brittany Ganson

  1) Public Comment:

  None

  2) Update on Fiscal year 2024-2025 Quarter One Programs and Initiatives for the
  Beverly Hills Chamber of Commerce:
  a. Presentation by Brittany Ganson:
  i. The Chamber has conducted Marketing and Outreach Support for City and
  Partner events such as: Les is More, 60 Second Shoutout, National Night
  Out
  ii. The Chamber conducted 6 Walk the Neighborhood outings focusing on
  Parking Garage Façade improvements, Rodeo Drive Celebrates Fashon,
  and Small Business Task Force Outreach.
  iii. The New York Business Attraction Mission held a delegation meeting on
  August 22nd in preparation for the upcoming trip.
  iv. The Chamber is continuing to conduct outreach and has confirmed
  meetings with several New York Businesses.
  v. The Chamber also conducted other economic development and business
  support meetings such as the Property Owner’s Task Force, Small
  Business Development Center, Small Business Task Force, Mayoral
  Business Retention Meetings, LA Metro Subway Stakeholder Meetings,
  and New Business Retention Meetings.
  vi. From August 1 to September 13, Now Beverly Hills’s Meta page had a
  271% increase in content interactions, a 22% increase in reach, and a
  16.7% increase in followers. The Instagram page had 151% uptick in
  impressions and a 166% increase in content interactions.
  vii. The first video in the Beyond the Counter video series on Instagram had
  66 total interactions and 415 views and is the highest performing video to
  date.
 Highlights for September 20, 2024
Chamber of Commerce Liaison Committee

  viii. Upcoming events are the Second Annual Rodeo Drive Celebrities
  Timepieces and Fine Jewelry in October, the Holiday Lighting Celebration
  in November, an Office Broker’s Roundtable on November 7, a Retail
  Broker’s Roundtable on December 5, and the Miami Business Attraction
  Mission in February 2025.
  b.  The Walk the Neighborhoods are when the Chamber’s Economic Development
  Manager goes to a specific area such as South Beverly and goes to all the
  businesses in the area over the course of an hour or two and discusses upcoming
  events that would affect the area. After the Walk the Economic Development
  Manager will write a report about the Walk. The reports are shared with the City
  either through a shared Google Drive or through a Check in with the Chamber.
  c.  The prior contractor for Now Beverly Hills had much lower engagement statistics
  than the current contractor who started in July.
  d.  Councilmember Wells is concerned about the costs of the social media contractor
  in relation to current levels of social media engagement.
  e.  The Chamber is predicting that the current levels of engagement will increase
  quarterly due to the new contractor.
  f.  The dates for the Miami trip are not finalized but will most likely be in February, the
  dates should be finalized before the end of the month.
  g.  The Small Business Task Force has been reaching out to restaurants about their
  participation in the permanent OpenBH program. 19 Businesses have not
  submitted their plans for the permanent OpenBH program, the deadline for which
  is October 1.
  h.  Now Beverly Hills does repost businesses’ social media posts to try and capture
  some of the businesses’ followers.
  i.  Several items that have been brought up in the Small Business and Property
  Owners Task Force Meetings have been included in programs such as Holiday
  Décor in certain areas. The Task Forces were critical in gathering information for
  OpenBH.

  3) Future Agenda Items:
  a. None

  4) Adjournment:
  Date / Time: September 20, 2024 / 11:52 AM
